newsitem.title: USA: U.S. officials discount Zaire massacre claim.
newsitem.headline: U.S. officials discount Zaire massacre claim.

text.p: U.S. officials said on Friday they were discounting claims by Zairean rebels that President Mobutu Sese Seko had ordered the massacre of all expatriates in Kinshasa.
"We have approached Mobutu's people about this and they've said it's absolute nonsense. It would make no sense," a State Department official said.
"Give it no credence. We're discounting it," he added.

An aide to rebel leader Laurent Kabila told reporters in Lubumbashi that Mobutu had ordered security forces to kill all expatriates in the Zairean capital in order to provoke foreign intervention and avert his downfall.
The rebels have captured almost half of Zaire in the past six months.
